verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-first banking platform, so its REST API can be called headlessly/in CI via HTTP Basic Auth (sandbox + ping/account endpoints, command-line or Postman testing), which supports automation-style usage. However there is no evidence of CI-specific tooling, an official SDK/CLI, webhooks for async automation, or a public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), so full headless/CI suitability is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: official CLI/SDK for CI pipelines, documented OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, CI examples or automation guides, and evidence of non-interactive auth flows beyond basic API key testing.
